title: LLM remediation plan (outer-remediate loop)
description: Shape emitted by the LLM during the outer-remediate loop. Lists specdev CLI commands to resolve spec-check findings, plus a rationale.

commands.description: Ordered list of specdev CLI commands to execute.

cmd.description: Full specdev CLI command string. Must begin with 'specdev '.

expected_effect.description: Brief description of the intended outcome of running this command.

rationale.description: Free-form explanation of the remediation approach and why these commands address the findings.
